_template_notes: fix-execution-result.json — Structured machine-readable execution result. Schema: fix-execution-result-v2 (v10.11.0). Backward-compatible: giữ nguyên field v1 top-level (fixed_total/deferred_total/failed_total/files_changed/files_changed_list/git_diff_summary/fix_report_path/docs_sync_report_path), bổ sung field v2 cho per-issue detail + audit_chain. Writer: scripts/wf-fix-bugs/verify-execute-outputs.sh (Phase 6 Step 6.7) — aggregate từ fix-log.json (structured per-issue) + git diff + extract counts. KHÔNG WRITE template thẳng — sẽ giữ {{...}} placeholders.
_schema_notes: Required (v2): $schema, session_id, generated_at, execution_mode, aggregated, issues[], audit_chain. issues[] item schema: {issue_id, dimension, action, result, files_touched[], duration_sec, retry_count, error_code, notes}. action ∈ {fix_attempt, skip, defer, cdg_blocked, manual_required}. result ∈ {success, failed, partial, pending}. aggregated keys: fixed_total, deferred_total, failed_total, skipped_total, total_issues_targeted, files_changed_count, duration_total_sec. audit_chain.checksum_sha256 = sha256 của fix-log.json (source SSOT).
